title: Parent delegation card and status summary omit findings and notes, so a non-clean result can read clean
outcome: Pre-existing and out of scope of w-a7c465026c6c. The parent card and the status projection show only compact_delegation_public_summary(result.summary): src/delegations.rs:3460-3486 (update_parent_delegation_card_locked with public_summary), :5096-5102 (delegation_result_summary), and ui/src/delegation-commands.ts:1097-1102. They have never carried findings or notes. A completed result whose summary begins clean-sounding, with a contradiction or a real finding appearing later, therefore reads clean on the card. The packet, the fan-in and termal_get_session_result do carry findings and the inconsistency note. Any change to what the card shows is user-facing and waits for Greg's input under his standing rule.
acceptance: Parent delegation card and status summary omit findings and notes, so a non-clean result can read clean is done
